761-762-763: Someone whose single kick leaves the other side with a wound to body and soul that will never heal.
A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.
764: Someone with a pleasant scent, and everyone like them wears different flowers, so each has a scent of their own.
These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.
765: Someone who knows their surroundings inside and out, and when they meet someone hurt, gathers healing herbs for them.
It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
766: Someone who lives in a big group where everyone has a role, and only through cooperation does everyone survive.
Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
767-768: Someone who lives among sunken remains, and when they fight a rival, the loser becomes the winner's meal.
They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.
769-770: Someone who lives by the water but hates it, because if they get too wet, they can't keep the shape they built for themselves.
This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.
771: Someone covered in a layer that keeps them moist, so they can hold out for days outside their natural place.
It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
774: Someone with an especially sturdy outer shell, which still shatters to pieces from the impact of landing.
Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
775: Someone who sleeps from birth to the very end, because of what they eat every day.
It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
776: Someone whom what they consume from their fiery surroundings makes explosive, and even what they leave behind is dangerous.
Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
777: Someone who, when in trouble, curls into a ball, raises their spikes and discharges in every direction indiscriminately.
When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
778: Someone who hides under an old costume, and whoever peeked underneath, even in the name of science, came to a bad end.
There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
779: Someone with skin thick enough to repel stings, who even chews the spikes of whoever attacks them.

780: A good, nice person, until the moment they're angered. Then they stir up a storm and flatten everything around.
Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
781: Someone who drops anchor and waits, and when something big is caught, drains its life force.
After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
782-783-784: Someone whose material ancient warriors wore as armor, because they're a symbol of protection and power.

793: Someone who came from another world, and seems to live off others, feeding on them to survive.

794: Someone who walks around showing off abnormally inflated muscles.
Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
795: Someone dangerous and foreign in this world, but probably quite ordinary in the place they came from.

796: Someone who can stand still like a tree, with hands and feet rooted deep in the ground.

797: Someone who seems foreign here and even threatening, but where they came from they're probably one of many.
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
798: A sharp, dangerous person who looks like an anomaly here, but in their own world is not unusual at all.
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
799: Someone no one really understands, who is probably always hungry and is surely always swallowing something.
An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
803-804: Someone who shoots glowing, toxic things, and what they shoot sticks and won't come off.
One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
805: Someone who looks like a quiet wall, until the wall starts moving and attacking, revealing what they really are.
When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
806: Someone who causes explosions, then uses everyone's surprise to drain their energy.
A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
810-811-812: Someone whose rhythm is the best, so they're the boss, but they have a gentle temper and keep harmony in the group.

813-814-815: Someone skilled in both attack and defense, who fills with energy when cheered on, but if they start showing off, may get into trouble.

816-817-818: Someone who sees exactly the other side's weak points and hits them precisely and efficiently.

819-820: Someone with strong teeth who can crack even the hardest shells to get at what's inside.
Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
821-822-823: Someone with great intelligence and maneuvering ability, who very successfully carries others from place to place.
With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.
824-825-826: Someone who broadcasts thought power to explore everything around them, even things miles away.

827-828: A flexible, nimble person who goes around stealing what others gathered, and has one clear natural enemy.

829-830: Someone whose output can be spun into a shiny, stunning thread, one of the most special things in the area.
The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
831-832: Someone with impressive horns meant only to impress, never used in a confrontation.
Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
837-838-839: Someone who heats up during a confrontation until they burn red, sending out sparks that scorch everything around.
While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

840-1011-1019: Someone made of several different moods, and only when they all line up together does their true power show.

846-847: Someone who builds up huge momentum and then rams straight into the target, without stopping before impact.

848-849: A hot-tempered, aggressive person who swallows even what's stale and moldy, to absorb every possible poison from it.
This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
850-851: Someone whose fire is dangerous enough on its own, and who also comes with excessive hostility and especially sharp teeth.
While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
852-853: Someone who leaves their area only to find someone to test their skills against, and goes home after the bout.

856-857-858: Someone who, if there's too much noise nearby, may tear apart whoever is making it, and some call them the witch of the forest.

859-860-861: Someone whose hair works like muscles, and when it spreads out, it grabs rivals and traps them.
Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
868-869: Someone who, when content, makes what they give others sweeter and richer.
When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
870: Someone who acts as part of a team that functions as one body, constantly changing formation when facing a challenge.
The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
871: Someone who stores energy in every spike, and even a broken spike keeps giving it off for hours.
It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
876: Someone who picks up the feelings of everyone around them, and good feelings are their source of power.
Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
880: Someone whose power comes from their strong lower half, compared to which the upper half is far too small.
The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
881: Someone who knew how to keep things cold so they'd last, but vanished from the world because they moved too slowly.
This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
